response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong software development skills and a diverse background across multiple domains, but his experience is heavily skewed toward web and full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js, React) rather than the C++-centric industrial automation focus required for this role. While he has some C/C++ exposure (e.g., National Instruments, Sound Position Server), it is not recent or extensive enough to confidently assess his fit for high-performance, secure, and scalable C++ systems in industrial automation.
strengths: Extensive experience with event-driven architectures, modular design, and distributed systems (e.g., GISCollective, Dunnhumby media).
Proven track record in secure development practices (e.g., TDD, CI/CD, SDL awareness) and technical leadership (mentoring, workshops).
Diverse technical background with exposure to networking, multi-threading, and low-latency systems (e.g., DLang, real-time metadata handling).
concerns: Limited recent and in-depth C++ experience; most roles emphasize TypeScript, Node.js, or other languages over C++/STL.
No explicit mention of industrial automation, IoT protocols (e.g., MQTT, OPC UA), or cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443).
Lack of cloud platform experience (e.g., Azure) or architectural documentation (UML, design patterns) in the resume.
